chapters.title: Default Settings are for Losers
chapters.goal: Survive the 'Impossible' Tutorial by exploiting a logic error in critical hit calculations to one-shot a scripted-death boss.
chapters.stakes_shift: From certain death to becoming a lethal glass cannon with a target on his back.

bridge.from_prev: The protagonist is pulled into the system with nothing but a snarky attitude and a penchant for breaking code.
bridge.to_next: Enters the main world map with an illegal stat spread and zero defense.

chapters.title: The RNG Whisperer
chapters.goal: Reach the hub city of Oakhaven while power-leveling on high-tier mobs that should be impossible to kill.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lucky survivor to an infamous 'glitcher' whose clear times are breaking the leaderboards.

bridge.from_prev: Enters the main world map with an illegal stat spread and zero defense.
bridge.to_next: Local authorities flag the protagonist's impossible clear times, initiating a silent hunt.

chapters.title: Aggro Management
chapters.goal: Evade the 'System Sentinels'—a guild of enforcers—by utilizing environmental exploits and social engineering.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a simple power-leveling run to a desperate game of cat-and-mouse where capture means a character wipe.

bridge.from_prev: Local authorities flag the protagonist's impossible clear times, initiating a silent hunt.
bridge.to_next: Forced into a corner, the protagonist attempts a high-risk exploit that triggers a mid-day system patch.

chapters.title: Patch Notes from Hell
chapters.goal: Adapt to the System's hotfix which nerfs his primary exploit, requiring him to find a 'Logic Breaker' artifact to stay relevant.
chapters.stakes_shift: From an overpowered exploiter to a vulnerable target who must now play by the rules—or find better ones.

bridge.from_prev: Forced into a corner, the protagonist attempts a high-risk exploit that triggers a mid-day system patch.
bridge.to_next: Deprived of his main exploit, he must infiltrate a high-security vault to find a more permanent 'Logic Breaker'.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon Run
chapters.goal: Infiltrate the Vault of Eternal Invariants to steal the artifact before the Sentinels lock down the zone.
chapters.stakes_shift: From reactive survival to an intentional disruption of the world's power balance.

bridge.from_prev: Deprived of his main exploit, he must infiltrate a high-security vault to find a more permanent 'Logic Breaker'.
bridge.to_next: Reaches the heart of the vault where the guardian and the ultimate loot await.

chapters.title: Maximum Over-Crit
chapters.goal: Defeat the Vault Guardian by combining the new artifact with a frame-perfect exploit, proving the system is still his plaything.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a hunted criminal to a recognized threat capable of destabilizing the entire game economy.

bridge.from_prev: Reaches the heart of the vault where the guardian and the ultimate loot await.
bridge.to_next: The vault collapses as the protagonist makes a desperate run for the exit with the artifact.

chapters.title: Loot, Scoot, and Reboot
chapters.goal: Escape the collapsing zone and vanish into the frontier, setting the stage for a larger rebellion against the System.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lone exploiter to a symbol of mechanical rebellion, with the entire world now looking for the 'Crit King'.

bridge.from_prev: The vault collapses as the protagonist makes a desperate run for the exit with the artifact.
bridge.to_next: Disappears into the unexplored wilds, ready to break the next set of rules.
